title: TotemVoid
description: A mod that make totems of undying work in the void
body:
**Void Totem**

A simple mod that lets your **Totem of Undying** save you from dying in the void.

If you fall into the void while holding a totem in your offhand, you’ll be safely teleported to your respawn point instead of dying.

Just keep a totem in your offhand — that’s it.
